analysis_note: The script audits public HEPData availability for AMS-02/CALET/DAMPE/CREAM high-energy flux tables. It does not claim a 1e-6 residual detection unless tables with covariance are parsed downstream.
data_source: HEPData public search API for cosmic-ray flux tables

falsification_logic.caveat: Most current public flux products are not precise enough for a strict 1e-6 test; likely an upper-limit audit.
falsification_logic.confirm_like: Parsed >1 TeV flux tables show stable residuals at the predicted level after spectral-model controls.
falsification_logic.falsify_like: Adequate high-energy public flux tables rule out residuals at the predicted level.
